description: This file defines a union 'sock_addr' for socket address representations supporting IPv4, IPv6, and Unix domain sockets, along with inline functions and external function declarations for manipulating socket addresses.

methods.name: int sock_addr_get_family(const sock_addr * saddr)
methods.description: Inline function returning the address family of the socket address.

methods.name: sock_addr_get_port
methods.description: Function to retrieve the port number from a socket address.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_wildcard
methods.description: Checks if the socket address is a wildcard address.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_family_eq
methods.description: Checks if two socket addresses are of the same address family.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_port_eq
methods.description: Checks if two socket addresses have the same port.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_eq
methods.description: Checks if two socket addresses are equal.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_eq_bits
methods.description: Checks if two socket addresses are equal up to a certain number of bits.

methods.name: sock_addr_set_port
methods.description: Sets the port for a socket address.

methods.name: sock_addr_assign
methods.description: Assigns a socket address with given family, port, and address.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_pton
methods.description: Converts an IP address from text to binary form and assigns it to a socket address.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop
methods.description: Converts a socket address to its textual representation.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop_copy_buffer
methods.description: Copies textual representation of socket address into a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends textual representation of socket address into a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_stringify_append_buffer
methods.description: Stringifies socket address and appends to buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_nameinfo_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends name info of socket address into buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_buffer_hints_numeric
methods.description: Creates a socket address from a buffer with hints for numeric address.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_str_hints
methods.description: Creates a socket address from string with family and port hints.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_str_numeric
methods.description: Creates a socket address from a numeric string.
